59: ## 2. Logic Chain
60: 
61: ### 2.1 Schema Design: `AppMetadata`
62: To provide fast, memory-efficient lookups without third-party dependencies, we evaluate two candidate data structures in pure Python standard library:
63: 
64: 1. **Option A: `@dataclass(frozen=True)`**
65:    - In Python 3.8 and 3.9, `@dataclass(slots=True)` is not supported (slots was introduced in Python 3.10). Without `__slots__`, every instance allocates a dynamic `__dict__` (~120–152 bytes overhead).
66: 2. **Option B: `typing.NamedTuple`**
67:    - Built into standard library across all supported Python versions (3.8–3.14).
68:    - Immutable and hashable.
69:    - Backed by standard tuple representation: memory footprint is only ~48 bytes per instance (60% less memory than unslotted dataclasses).
70:    - Supports tuple indexing, unpacking (`name, category = metadata[:2]`), named attribute access (`metadata.name`, `metadata.category`), and built-in dictionary conversion (`metadata._asdict()` / `.to_dict()`).
71: 
72: **Decision**: Use `NamedTuple` for `AppMetadata`:
73: ```python
74: class AppMetadata(NamedTuple):
75:     name: str
76:     category: str
77:     is_known: bool = True
78:     package_name: str = ""
79: 
80:     def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
81:         return {
82:             "name": self.name,
83:             "category": self.category,
84:             "is_known": self.is_known,
85:             "package_name": self.package_name,
86:         }
87: ```
88: 
89: ### 2.2 Category Taxonomy
90: We establish eight core functional categories represented by frozen string constants, plus a generic fallback:
91: - `CATEGORY_STREAMING = "Streaming"`: Subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) and ad-supported streaming (AVOD).
92: - `CATEGORY_MEDIA = "Media Players"`: Local/network video players, media centers, IPTV clients, UPnP/DLNA streamers.
93: - `CATEGORY_AUDIO = "Music & Audio"`: Music streaming services, radio stations, podcast clients.
94: - `CATEGORY_LIVE_TV = "Live TV & Sports"`: Live broadcast networks, sports packages, regional channels.
95: - `CATEGORY_TOOLS = "Utilities & Tools"`: File managers, web browsers, speed tests, remote remappers, VPNs.
96: - `CATEGORY_GAMES = "Games & Emulators"`: Retro emulators, cloud gaming clients, Android TV games.
97: - `CATEGORY_OEM = "OEM Components"`: Hardware-specific vendor services (Sony, TCL, Philips, Hisense, Xiaomi, Nvidia).
98: - `CATEGORY_SYSTEM = "System & Core"`: Android platform frameworks, Google Play services, TV Input Framework, settings providers.
99: - `CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS = "Applications"`: Fallback genre for unrecognized applications.
100: 
101: ### 2.3 Storage Architecture & O(1) Performance
102: Storing the catalog as a dictionary of `package_name: (display_name, category)` tuples:
103: - **Hash Table Efficiency**: CPython open-addressing dictionary provides true O(1) lookup time (~30–45 nanoseconds).
104: - **Zero Startup Lag**: Initializing a 350-entry static dictionary at module import consumes < 1 millisecond CPU time and ~16 KB RAM.
105: - **Normalization**: Package names are case-folded and whitespace-stripped (`package_name.strip().lower()`), ensuring resilience against irregular casing.
106: - **Lazy Object Creation**: Tuples in the catalog are instantiated as `AppMetadata` objects upon request, avoiding unnecessary pre-allocation of hundreds of unused instances.

936: def normalize_package_name(package_name: str) -> str:
937:     """Strip whitespace and normalize to lowercase for O(1) dictionary key lookup."""
938:     if not package_name:
939:         return ""
940:     return package_name.strip().lower()
941: 
942: 
943: def get_app_metadata(
944:     package_name: str,
945:     fallback_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], Tuple[str, str]]] = None,
946: ) -> AppMetadata:
947:     """
948:     Resolve an Android package ID to its friendly display name and category.
949:     Performs pure O(1) dictionary lookup in APP_CATALOG.
950:     If not found, delegates to the fallback tokenizer.
951: 
952:     Args:
953:         package_name: Reverse-domain Android package name (e.g., 'com.netflix.ninja').
954:         fallback_resolver: Optional callable accepting a package name and returning (name, category).
955:             If omitted, uses the built-in fallback tokenizer.
956: 
957:     Returns:
958:         AppMetadata NamedTuple containing name, category, is_known, and package_name.
959:     """
960:     clean_pkg = (package_name or "").strip()
961:     norm_pkg = clean_pkg.lower()
962: 
963:     if not norm_pkg:
964:         return AppMetadata(name="Unknown", category=CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS, is_known=False, package_name="")
965: 
966:     # O(1) Catalog lookup
967:     catalog_hit = APP_CATALOG.get(norm_pkg)
968:     if catalog_hit is not None:
969:         return AppMetadata(
970:             name=catalog_hit[0],
971:             category=catalog_hit[1],
972:             is_known=True,
973:             package_name=clean_pkg,
974:         )
975: 
976:     # Fallback to heuristic normalizer
977:     resolver = fallback_resolver or tokenize_fallback
978:     fallback_name, fallback_cat = resolver(clean_pkg)
979:     return AppMetadata(
980:         name=fallback_name,
981:         category=fallback_cat,
982:         is_known=False,
983:         package_name=clean_pkg,
984:     )
985: 
986: 
987: def resolve_app_name(package_name: str) -> str:
988:     """Convenience helper returning only the friendly display name."""
989:     return get_app_metadata(package_name).name
990: 
991: 
992: def get_app_category(package_name: str) -> str:
993:     """Convenience helper returning only the functional category."""
994:     return get_app_metadata(package_name).category
995: 
996: 
997: def is_known_app(package_name: str) -> bool:
998:     """Check if package exists in the curated catalog."""
999:     return normalize_package_name(package_name) in APP_CATALOG

78: ## 2. Logic Chain
79: 
80: To transform raw reverse-domain identifiers into publication-grade, human-readable display names and accurate categories, the algorithm executes the following 8-stage transformation pipeline:
81: 
82: ### Stage 1: Bounded Input Sanitation & Guardrails
83: - **Pre-condition**: Input can be `None`, empty string, whitespace, non-string object, or an adversarial 10,000-character payload.
84: - **Rule**:
85:   1. Validate `isinstance(raw_pkg, str)`. If not, or if stripped length is 0, return `AppInfo(package_name="", name="Unknown", category="Applications", is_known=False)`.
86:   2. Bounded length: truncate input to `raw_pkg.strip()[:512]` to strictly prevent regex ReDoS or memory abuse while exceeding Android's standard 256-character package name limit.
87:   3. If input is entirely uppercase (`s.isupper()`), convert to lowercase initially (`s.lower()`) so camelCase and acronym extractors can process it without being blinded by all-caps user inputs.
88: 
89: ### Stage 2: Reverse-Domain Prefix Stripping
90: - **Mechanism**: Match against a deterministic tuple of known prefixes sorted by descending length (e.g. `com.google.android.apps.tv.` before `com.google.android.` before `com.app.` before `com.`).
91: - **Safety Invariant**: Only strip if `len(package_name) > len(prefix)`. If stripping would leave an empty string (e.g. `package_name == "com"`), do not strip.
92: - **Sample Transformations**:
93:   - `com.google.android.youtube.tv` $\rightarrow$ `youtube.tv`
94:   - `com.netflix.ninja` $\rightarrow$ `netflix.ninja`
95:   - `org.videolan.vlc` $\rightarrow$ `videolan.vlc`
96:   - `tv.twitch.android.app` $\rightarrow$ `twitch.android.app`
97:   - `uk.co.bbc.iplayer` $\rightarrow$ `bbc.iplayer`
98:   - `io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager` $\rightarrow$ `muntashirakon.AppManager`
99:   - `android.auto` $\rightarrow$ `auto`
100: 
101: ### Stage 3: Delimiter Splitting & Trailing Filler Elimination
102: - **Mechanism**: Split the cleaned string on delimiters `[._\-+/: ]+` into discrete segments.
103: - **Filler Pruning**: Iteratively prune trailing segments while length $> 1$ and the last segment is in `FILLER_SUFFIXES = {'android', 'app', 'application', 'mobile', 'release', 'debug', 'package'}`:
104:   ```python
105:   while len(segments) > 1 and segments[-1].lower() in FILLER_SUFFIXES:
106:       segments.pop()
107:   ```
108: - **Preservation Rule**: Keep `.tv` and `.atv` (these are meaningful broadcast/device indicators, not boilerplate).
109: - **Sample Transformations**:
110:   - `twitch.android.app` $\rightarrow$ segments `['twitch', 'android', 'app']` $\rightarrow$ pruned to `['twitch']`
111:   - `spotify.tv.android` $\rightarrow$ segments `['spotify', 'tv', 'android']` $\rightarrow$ pruned to `['spotify', 'tv']`
112:   - `com.app` $\rightarrow$ segment `['app']` $\rightarrow$ preserved as `['app']` (length is 1, never pruned to empty)

213: ## 3. Caveats
214: 
215: 1. **Obfuscated Package Names**: Highly obfuscated third-party packages (e.g. `a.b.c.d.e` or `com.x81249.p9218`) will be cleanly capitalized (e.g. `A B C D E` or `X 81249 P 9218`), but cannot reveal their secret commercial brand name without an explicit catalog entry.
216: 2. **Catalog Precedence**: The tokenized fallback heuristic is designed as an automatic fallback when a package is *not* present in the curated ~250 catalog (`CATALOG`) or debloat safety database (`PackageSafetyDB`). The curated catalog should always be checked first for exact brand names (e.g., `com.netflix.ninja` $\rightarrow$ `Netflix` rather than `Netflix Ninja`).
217: 3. **Compound Word Heuristic Boundaries**: Compound decomposition is intentionally bounded to common TV, media, and file utility words (`video`, `media`, `smart`, `file`, `speed`, `player`, `center`, `tube`, `manager`, etc.). Rare concatenated words without camelCase or separators will default to standard initial capitalization (e.g., `com.foo.barbaz` $\rightarrow$ `Barbaz`).

393: def tokenize_package_name(raw_pkg: Optional[str], max_len: int = 512) -> List[str]:
394:     """
395:     Tokenizes a package name across dots, camelCase, snake_case, numbers,
396:     and compound words into normalized tokens.

398:     if not raw_pkg or not isinstance(raw_pkg, str):
399:         return []

401:     s = raw_pkg.strip()[:max_len]

403:         return []
404: 
405:     # Handle all-uppercase strings
406:     if s.isupper():

409:     cleaned = strip_reverse_domain_prefix(s)

411:     # Split across standard delimiters
412:     segments = [seg for seg in re.split(r"[._\-+/: ]+", cleaned) if seg]
413:     if not segments:
414:         segments = [seg for seg in re.split(r"[._\-+/: ]+", s) if seg]
415:     if not segments:
416:         return [s]
417: 
418:     # Drop trailing filler words while multiple segments exist
419:     while len(segments) > 1 and segments[-1].lower() in FILLER_SUFFIXES:
420:         segments.pop()
421: 
422:     raw_tokens: List[str] = []
423:     prev_segment = ""
424:     for seg in segments:
425:         lower_seg = seg.lower()
426: 
427:         # Check if segment begins with preceding segment (e.g. amazon -> amazonvideo)
428:         if prev_segment and len(prev_segment) >= 3 and lower_seg.startswith(prev_segment) and len(lower_seg) > len(prev_segment):
429:             rem = lower_seg[len(prev_segment):]
430:             raw_tokens.extend([prev_segment, rem])
431:             prev_segment = lower_seg
432:             continue
433:         prev_segment = lower_seg
434: 
435:         split_compound = False
436:         for pfx in COMPOUND_PREFIXES:
437:             if lower_seg.startswith(pfx):
438:                 rem = lower_seg[len(pfx):]
439:                 for sfx in COMPOUND_SUFFIXES:
440:                     if rem == sfx:

442:                         split_compound = True

444:             if split_compound:

447:         if not split_compound:

449:             if matches:

451:             else:
452:                 raw_tokens.append(seg)

454:     # Normalize tokens and deduplicate case-insensitively
455:     normalized: List[str] = []
456:     seen: Set[str] = set()
457:     for tok in raw_tokens:
458:         tok_low = tok.lower()
459:         if tok_low in seen:
460:             continue
461:         seen.add(tok_low)

463:         up = tok.upper()
464:         if up in KNOWN_ACRONYMS:

414: """
415: OpenTV Friendly Package Name & Metadata Engine.
416: Milestone 4: Maps Android package IDs to human-readable names and categories,
417: with pure standard library tokenized fallback heuristics for uncataloged packages.
418: """
419: from __future__ import annotations
420: 
421: import re
422: from dataclasses import dataclass
423: from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
424: 
425: @dataclass(frozen=True)
426: class AppMetadata:
427:     name: str
428:     package_name: str
429:     category: str
430:     is_known: bool = True
431: 
432: ACRONYMS = {
433:     "tv": "TV", "hd": "HD", "iptv": "IPTV", "ott": "OTT", "vlc": "VLC",
434:     "ui": "UI", "sdk": "SDK", "dvr": "DVR", "fm": "FM", "am": "AM",
435:     "av": "AV", "oled": "OLED", "hdr": "HDR", "4k": "4K", "8k": "8K",
436:     "vpn": "VPN", "ftp": "FTP", "smb": "SMB", "dlna": "DLNA", "upnp": "UPnP",
437:     "usb": "USB", "lan": "LAN", "wifi": "Wi-Fi", "dns": "DNS", "ip": "IP",
438: }
439: 
440: DOMAIN_PREFIXES = (
441:     "com.google.android.", "com.android.", "org.videolan.", "org.xbmc.",
442:     "com.", "org.", "net.", "io.", "co.", "tv.", "app.", "android.", "vendor.",
443: )
444: 
445: # CATALOG: ~250 Curated Android TV Packages (populated by Explorer 1)
446: CATALOG: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {
447:     "com.netflix.ninja": ("Netflix", "Video & Streaming"),
448:     "com.google.android.youtube.tv": ("YouTube", "Video & Streaming"),
449:     "com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom": ("Prime Video", "Video & Streaming"),
450:     "com.disney.disneyplus": ("Disney+", "Video & Streaming"),
451:     "com.plexapp.android": ("Plex", "Media & Players"),
452:     "org.xbmc.kodi": ("Kodi", "Media & Players"),
453:     "org.videolan.vlc": ("VLC", "Media & Players"),
454:     "com.spotify.tv.android": ("Spotify", "Music & Audio"),
455:     "com.retroarch": ("RetroArch", "Gaming & Emulation"),
456:     "com.android.vending": ("Google Play Store", "System"),
457:     "com.sony.dtv.braviasync": ("Bravia Sync", "OEM & Vendor"),
458: }
459: 
460: def resolve_fallback_name(package_name: str) -> str:
461:     """Heuristic tokenization across camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and reverse domain prefixes."""
462:     if not package_name or not package_name.strip():
463:         return "Unknown App"
464: 
465:     pkg = package_name.strip()
466:     for prefix in DOMAIN_PREFIXES:
467:         if pkg.startswith(prefix) and len(pkg) > len(prefix):
468:             pkg = pkg[len(prefix):]
469:             break
470: 
471:     # Split on dots, take the meaningful segments (last 1-2)
472:     segments = [s for s in pkg.split(".") if s]
473:     if not segments:
474:         return "Unknown App"
475:     
476:     target_segment = " ".join(segments[-2:]) if len(segments) >= 2 and segments[-1] in ("tv", "atv", "app") else segments[-1]
477: 
478:     # Split camelCase and replace snake/kebab delimiters
479:     spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", target_segment)
480:     spaced = re.sub(r"[_\-\.]+", " ", spaced).strip()
481: 
482:     tokens = spaced.split()
483:     formatted_tokens = []
484:     for t in tokens:
485:         lower = t.lower()
486:         if lower in ACRONYMS:
487:             formatted_tokens.append(ACRONYMS[lower])
488:         else:
489:             formatted_tokens.append(t.capitalize())
490: 
491:     return " ".join(formatted_tokens) if formatted_tokens else "Unknown App"
492: 
493: def infer_fallback_category(package_name: str, friendly_name: str) -> str:

    'video', 'media', 'smart', 'speed', 'file', 'screen', 'sound', 'html',
    'print', 'air', 'radio', 'tv', 'web', 'game', 'audio', 'cast', 'live',

    'ultra', 'mega', 'easy', 'fast', 'auto', 'photo', 'voice', 'cloud', 'task',
    'living', 'system', 'input'
], key=len, reverse=True))

COMPOUND_SUFFIXES = tuple(sorted([
    'player', 'center', 'tube', 'test', 'manager', 'explorer', 'mirror',
    'picker', 'viewer', 'spooler', 'play', 'fm', 'am', 'menu', 'launcher',

    | (?:[vV][0-9]+)
    | [A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE]+(?=[A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE][a-z\u00DF-\u00FF]|\d|\b)
    | [A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE]?[a-z\u00DF-\u00FF]+

    cleaned = pkg.strip()
    for pfx in KNOWN_PREFIXES:
        if cleaned.lower().startswith(pfx) and len(cleaned) > len(pfx):

def tokenize_package_name(raw_pkg: Optional[str], max_len: int = 512) -> List[str]:

    if not s:
        return []

        s = s.lower()
    cleaned = strip_reverse_domain_prefix(s)
    segments = [seg for seg in re.split(r'[._\-+/: ]+', cleaned) if seg]

        prev_segment = lower_seg
        split_compound = False
        for pfx in COMPOUND_PREFIXES:

                rem = lower_seg[len(pfx):]
                for sfx in COMPOUND_SUFFIXES:

    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for tok in raw_tokens:
        tok_low = tok.lower()
        if tok_low in seen:

        seen.add(tok_low)
        up = tok.upper()
        if up in KNOWN_ACRONYMS:
            normalized.append(up)
        elif tok_low in BRAND_CASING:
            normalized.append(BRAND_CASING[tok_low])
        elif len(tok_low) >= 2 and tok_low[0] == 'v' and tok_low[1:].isdigit():
            normalized.append(f'V{tok_low[1:]}')
        elif tok.isdigit():
            normalized.append(tok)
        else:
            normalized.append(tok[:1].upper() + tok[1:])

    all_terms = set(t.lower() for t in tokens)

    def has_any(*keywords: str) -> bool:
        return any(k in all_terms or any(k in t for t in all_terms) for k in keywords)

    if has_any('iptv', 'livetv', 'sports', 'sport', 'broadcast', 'channel', 'tuner', 'epg', 'dvb', 'atsc', 'espn', 'sling', 'fubo', 'tivimate', 'ott', 'dvr', 'pvr', 'antenna'):
        return 'Live TV & Sports'
    if has_any('stream', 'video', 'movie', 'cinema', 'film', 'theater', 'player', 'media', 'plex', 'kodi', 'jellyfin', 'emby', 'vlc', 'tube', 'netflix', 'primevideo', 'disney', 'hulu', 'peacock', 'paramount', 'max', 'hbo', 'crunchyroll', 'anime', 'cast', 'screenmirror', 'airplay', 'dlna'):
        return 'Streaming & Video'
    if has_any('tool', 'util', 'file', 'explorer', 'commander', 'manager', 'downloader', 'clean', 'speed', 'speedtest', 'backup', 'network', 'wifi', 'vpn', 'remote', 'adb', 'dns', 'terminal', 'monitor', 'cpu', 'task', 'benchmark', 'installer', 'sideload', 'xplore'):
        return 'Tools & Utilities'
    if has_any('system', 'setting', 'settings', 'setup', 'provision', 'service', 'framework', 'keyboard', 'ime', 'inputmethod', 'bluetooth', 'driver', 'oem', 'updater', 'ota'):
        return 'System & OEM'
    return 'Applications'

class AppMetadata(NamedTuple):

def fallback_app_info(package_name: str) -> AppMetadata:
    if not package_name or not isinstance(package_name, str):

TOKEN_PATTERN: re.Pattern = re.compile(
    r"""
    (?:[0-9]+[kKdD])                                                        # 4k, 8k, 3d, 2d
    | (?:[mM][pP][34])                                                      # mp3, mp4, MP3, MP4
    | (?:[hH]26[45])                                                        # h264, h265
    | (?:[vV][0-9]+)                                                        # v2, v3, V2
    | [A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE]+(?=[A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE][a-z\u00DF-\u00FF]|\d|\b)    # Acronyms before TitleCase or digits
    | [A-Z\u00C0-\u00DE]?[a-z\u00DF-\u00FF]+                               # TitleCase or lowercase words
    | [0-9]+                                                                # Standalone numbers
    """,
    re.VERBOSE,
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Algorithmic Functions & Heuristics
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def infer_brand(package_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Infers manufacturer / brand affiliation from package name."""
    if not package_name:
        return None
    pkg = package_name.lower()
    if "sony" in pkg:
        return "sony"
    if "tcl" in pkg:
        return "tcl"
    if "droidtv" in pkg or "philips" in pkg:
        return "philips"
    if "hisense" in pkg or "jamdeo" in pkg or "vidaa" in pkg:
        return "hisense"
    if "xiaomi" in pkg or "mitv" in pkg:
        return "xiaomi"
    if "nvidia" in pkg:
        return "nvidia"
    if pkg.startswith("com.google.") or pkg.startswith("com.android.") or pkg == "android":
        return "google"
    if "amazon" in pkg:
        return "amazon"
    if "netflix" in pkg:
        return "netflix"
    if "apple" in pkg:
        return "apple"
    return None


def strip_reverse_domain_prefix(pkg: str) -> str:
    """Strips leading reverse-DNS TLDs, ccTLDs, or platform prefixes."""
    cleaned = (pkg or "").strip()
    for pfx in KNOWN_PREFIXES:
        if cleaned.lower().startswith(pfx) and len(cleaned) > len(pfx):
            return cleaned[len(pfx):]
    return cleaned


def tokenize_package_name(raw_pkg: Optional[str], max_len: int = 512) -> List[str]:
    """
    Tokenizes a package name across dots, camelCase, snake_case, numbers,
    and compound words into normalized tokens.
    """
    if not raw_pkg or not isinstance(raw_pkg, str):
        return []

    s = raw_pkg.strip()[:max_len]
    if not s:
        return []

    # Handle all-uppercase inputs
    if s.isupper():
        s = s.lower()

    cleaned = strip_reverse_domain_prefix(s)

    # Split across standard delimiters
    segments = [seg for seg in re.split(r"[._\-+/: ]+", cleaned) if seg]
    if not segments:
        segments = [seg for seg in re.split(r"[._\-+/: ]+", s) if seg]
    if not segments:
        return [s]

    # Drop trailing filler words while multiple segments exist
    while len(segments) > 1 and segments[-1].lower() in FILLER_SUFFIXES:
        segments.pop()

    raw_tokens: List[str] = []
    prev_segment = ""
    for seg in segments:
        lower_seg = seg.lower()

        # Check if segment begins with preceding segment (e.g. amazon -> amazonvideo)
        if (
            prev_segment
            and len(prev_segment) >= 3
            and lower_seg.startswith(prev_segment)
            and len(lower_seg) > len(prev_segment)
        ):
            rem = lower_seg[len(prev_segment):]
            raw_tokens.extend([prev_segment, rem])
            prev_segment = lower_seg
            continue
        prev_segment = lower_seg

        split_compound = False
        for pfx in COMPOUND_PREFIXES:
            if lower_seg.startswith(pfx):
                rem = lower_seg[len(pfx):]
                for sfx in COMPOUND_SUFFIXES:
                    if rem == sfx:
                        raw_tokens.extend([pfx, sfx])
                        split_compound = True
                        break
            if split_compound:
                break

        if not split_compound:
            matches = TOKEN_PATTERN.findall(seg)
            if matches:
                raw_tokens.extend(matches)
            else:
                raw_tokens.append(seg)

    # Normalize tokens and deduplicate case-insensitively
    normalized: List[str] = []
    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for tok in raw_tokens:
        tok_low = tok.lower()
        if tok_low in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(tok_low)

        up = tok.upper()
        if up in KNOWN_ACRONYMS:
            normalized.append(up)
        elif tok_low in BRAND_CASING:
            normalized.append(BRAND_CASING[tok_low])
        elif len(tok_low) >= 2 and tok_low[0] == "v" and tok_low[1:].isdigit():
            normalized.append(f"V{tok_low[1:]}")
        elif tok.isdigit():
            normalized.append(tok)
        else:
            normalized.append(tok[:1].upper() + tok[1:])

    return normalized


def infer_category(tokens: List[str], raw_package: str = "") -> str:
    """
    Infers standard category from token list and raw package name
    following Explorer 2's 9-tier priority hierarchy.
    """
    all_terms = set(t.lower() for t in tokens)
    for seg in (raw_package or "").lower().split("."):
        all_terms.add(seg)

    def has_any(*keywords: str) -> bool:
        return any(k in all_terms or any(k in t for t in all_terms) for k in keywords)

    # 1. Launcher (highest precedence for shells/launchers)
    if has_any("launcher", "leanbacklauncher", "homemenu", "tvmenu", "homescreen", "projmymenu"):
        return CATEGORY_LAUNCHER

    # 2. Web Browser
    if has_any(
        "browser", "chrome", "firefox", "opera", "edge", "brave", "silk",
        "vivaldi", "puffin", "duckduckgo", "navigator",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_BROWSER

    # 3. Games & Emulation
    if has_any(
        "game", "arcade", "retro", "emulator", "retroarch", "ppsspp", "mame",
        "steamlink", "geforcenow", "moonlight", "playstation", "xbox", "nintendo",
        "sega", "rom", "controller", "joystick",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_GAMING

    # 4. Music & Audio
    if has_any(
        "music", "radio", "audio", "sound", "podcast", "tunein", "spotify",
        "deezer", "tidal", "pandora", "iheart", "soundcloud", "shazam",
        "audiomack", "ytmusic", "mp3", "flac", "equalizer",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_AUDIO

    # 5. Live TV & Sports
    if has_any(
        "iptv", "livetv", "sports", "sport", "broadcast", "channel", "tuner",
        "epg", "dvb", "atsc", "espn", "sling", "fubo", "tivimate", "ott",
        "dvr", "pvr", "antenna",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_LIVE_TV

    # 6. Streaming & Video (Media Centers & Players)
    if has_any(
        "stream", "video", "movie", "cinema", "film", "theater", "player",
        "media", "plex", "kodi", "jellyfin", "emby", "vlc", "tube", "netflix",
        "primevideo", "disney", "hulu", "peacock", "paramount", "max", "hbo",
        "crunchyroll", "anime", "cast", "screenmirror", "airplay", "dlna",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_STREAMING_VIDEO

    # 7. Tools & Utilities
    if has_any(
        "tool", "util", "file", "explorer", "commander", "manager",
        "downloader", "clean", "speed", "speedtest", "backup", "network",
        "wifi", "vpn", "remote", "adb", "dns", "terminal", "monitor", "cpu",
        "task", "benchmark", "installer", "sideload", "xplore",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_TOOLS_UTILITIES

    # 8. System & OEM
    if has_any(
        "system", "setting", "settings", "setup", "provision", "service",
        "framework", "keyboard", "ime", "inputmethod", "bluetooth", "driver",
        "oem", "updater", "ota",
    ):
        return CATEGORY_SYSTEM_OEM

    return CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS


def resolve_fallback_name(package_name: str) -> str:
    """Convenience helper extracting tokenized fallback display name."""
    if not package_name or not isinstance(package_name, str) or not package_name.strip():
        return "Unknown"
    tokens = tokenize_package_name(package_name)
    return " ".join(tokens) if tokens else package_name.strip()


def infer_fallback_category(package_name: str, friendly_name: str = "") -> str:
    """Convenience helper inferring fallback category from package ID and name."""
    tokens = tokenize_package_name(f"{package_name} {friendly_name}")
    return infer_category(tokens, package_name)


def fallback_app_info(package_name: str) -> AppMetadata:
    """
    Generates an AppMetadata instance for an unlisted package using token heuristics.
    Adheres strictly to Explorer 2's benchmarked algorithm.
    """
    if not package_name or not isinstance(package_name, str):
        return AppMetadata(
            name="Unknown",
            category=CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS,
            is_known=False,
            package_name=str(package_name or ""),
            brand=None,
        )

    clean = package_name.strip()
    if not clean:
        return AppMetadata(
            name="Unknown",
            category=CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS,
            is_known=False,
            package_name="",
            brand=None,
        )

    tokens = tokenize_package_name(clean)
    name = " ".join(tokens) if tokens else clean
    category = infer_category(tokens, clean)

    return AppMetadata(
        name=name,
        category=category,
        is_known=False,
        package_name=clean,
        brand=infer_brand(clean),
    )


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public API
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def normalize_package_name(package_name: str) -> str:
    """Strip whitespace and normalize to lowercase for O(1) dictionary key lookup."""
    if not package_name:
        return ""
    return package_name.strip().lower()


def get_app_metadata(
    package_name: str,
    fallback_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], Tuple[str, str]]] = None,
) -> AppMetadata:
    """
    Resolve an Android package ID to its friendly display name and category.
    Performs pure O(1) dictionary lookup in CATALOG.
    If not found, delegates to the fallback tokenizer.

    Args:
        package_name: Reverse-domain Android package name (e.g. 'com.netflix.ninja').
        fallback_resolver: Optional callable accepting a package name and returning (name, category).
            If omitted, uses the built-in fallback tokenizer.

    Returns:
        AppMetadata NamedTuple containing (name, category, is_known, package_name, brand).
    """
    clean_pkg = (package_name or "").strip()
    norm_pkg = clean_pkg.lower()

    if not norm_pkg:
        return AppMetadata(
            name="Unknown",
            category=CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS,
            is_known=False,
            package_name="",
            brand=None,
        )

    # O(1) Catalog lookup
    if norm_pkg in CATALOG:
        val = CATALOG[norm_pkg]
        name = val[0]
        category = val[1]
        brand = val[2] if len(val) >= 3 else infer_brand(clean_pkg)
        return AppMetadata(
            name=name,
            category=category,
            is_known=True,
            package_name=clean_pkg,
            brand=brand,
        )

    # Fallback to custom resolver if provided
    if fallback_resolver is not None:
        fb_name, fb_cat = fallback_resolver(clean_pkg)
        return AppMetadata(
            name=fb_name,
            category=fb_cat,
            is_known=False,
            package_name=clean_pkg,
            brand=infer_brand(clean_pkg),
        )

    # Standard fallback heuristic
    return fallback_app_info(clean_pkg)


def resolve_app(package_name: str) -> AppMetadata:
    """Primary API: Resolves an Android TV package name to AppMetadata."""
    return get_app_metadata(package_name)


def get_app_name(package_name: str) -> str:
    """Convenience helper returning only the friendly display name."""
    return get_app_metadata(package_name).name


def get_app_category(package_name: str) -> str:
    """Convenience helper returning only the functional category."""
    return get_app_metadata(package_name).category


def is_known_app(package_name: str) -> bool:
    """Check if package exists in the curated catalog."""
    if not package_name:
        return False
    return package_name.strip().lower() in CATALOG


def format_app_display(
    app: Union[str, AppMetadata],
    include_category: bool = True,
    bracket_name: bool = True,
    safety_label: Optional[str] = None,
    max_width: Optional[int] = None,
    max_name_len: Optional[int] = None,
    template: Optional[str] = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Format package into standard UI string for CLI / TUI screens.

    Default Format:
        '[Friendly Name] (package.id) - [Category]'
    Example:
        '[Netflix] (com.netflix.ninja) - [Streaming]'
    With Safety Label:
        '[Sony BRAVIA Sync] (com.sony.dtv.braviasync) - [OEM Components / SAFE]'
    Without Category:
        '[Netflix] (com.netflix.ninja)'
    """
    if isinstance(app, str):
        meta = resolve_app(app)
        pkg_name = meta.package_name or app.strip()
    else:
        meta = app
        pkg_name = meta.package_name

    name = meta.name
    if max_name_len and len(name) > max_name_len:
        name = name[: max_name_len - 3] + "..."

    if template is not None:
        return template.format(
            name=name,
            package=pkg_name,
            category=meta.category,
            is_known=meta.is_known,
            brand=meta.brand,
        )

    name_str = f"[{name}]" if bracket_name else name

    if safety_label and include_category:
        cat_suffix = f" - [{meta.category} / {safety_label}]"
    elif safety_label:
        cat_suffix = f" - [{safety_label}]"
    elif include_category:
        cat_suffix = f" - [{meta.category}]"
    else:
        cat_suffix = ""

    formatted = f"{name_str} ({pkg_name}){cat_suffix}"
    if max_width and len(formatted) > max_width:
        formatted = formatted[: max_width - 3] + "..."
    return formatted


def list_catalog_apps(category: Optional[str] = None) -> List[AppMetadata]:
    """Return all curated catalog entries, optionally filtered by category."""
    results: List[AppMetadata] = []
    for pkg, (name, cat) in sorted(CATALOG.items()):
        if category is None or cat == category:
            results.append(
                AppMetadata(
                    name=name,
                    category=cat,
                    is_known=True,
                    package_name=pkg,
                    brand=infer_brand(pkg),
                )
            )
    return results


def get_catalog_stats() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return statistical summary of the curated catalog."""
    counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for _, cat in CATALOG.values():
        counts[cat] = counts.get(cat, 0) + 1
    return {
        "total_curated_apps": len(CATALOG),
        "categories": counts,
    }

"""

- Acronym and official brand casing preservation.
- Category inference across 9 priority tiers.
- Display formatting ([Friendly Name] (pkg.id) - [Category/Safety]).
- CLI integration (list-apps --raw, enriched JSON, debloat summaries).
- TUI integration (grid preview labels, device package metadata).
- Performance throughput (>10,000 lookups/sec).
"""
import io
import json
import time
import unittest
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from opentv import cli
from opentv.core.app_names import (
    ALL_CATEGORIES,

    CATALOG,

    CATEGORY_AUDIO,
    CATEGORY_BROWSER,
    CATEGORY_GAMES,
    CATEGORY_GAMING,
    CATEGORY_LAUNCHER,
    CATEGORY_LIVE_TV,
    CATEGORY_MEDIA,

    CATEGORY_SYSTEM,
    CATEGORY_SYSTEM_OEM,

# ==============================================================================
# Suite 1: Curated Catalog Lookups & Architecture
# ==============================================================================

    """Verifies curated catalog size, categorization, schema, and O(1) lookups."""

    def test_catalog_size_and_type(self):

        for pkg, val in CATALOG.items():

    def test_streaming_services_catalog(self):
        """Major streaming platforms resolve accurately with Category Streaming."""

        for pkg, expected_name in streaming_checks:
            meta = get_app_metadata(pkg)

            self.assertTrue(meta.is_known)

        """Media players and centers resolve accurately with Category Media Players."""

        live_checks = [

        ]
        for pkg, expected_name in live_checks:
            meta = get_app_metadata(pkg)
            self.assertEqual(meta.name, expected_name)
            self.assertEqual(meta.category, CATEGORY_LIVE_TV)

    def test_tools_utilities_catalog(self):
        """File managers, tools, and browsers resolve with Category Utilities & Tools."""
        tools_checks = [
            ("com.esotericsoftware.clouddrive", "Downloader by AFTVnews"),

    def test_gaming_emulation_catalog(self):
        """Games and emulators resolve with Category Games & Emulators."""
        game_checks = [
            ("com.retroarch", "RetroArch"),
            ("com.retroarch.aarch64", "RetroArch Plus"),

        for pkg, expected_name in game_checks:
            meta = get_app_metadata(pkg)

    def test_oem_vendor_packages_catalog(self):
        """OEM specific packages resolve with Category OEM Components and brand."""
        oem_checks = [
            ("com.sony.dtv.tvx", "Sony Live TV / HDMI", "sony"),
            ("com.sony.dtv.braviasync", "Sony BRAVIA Sync", "sony"),

    def test_android_core_system_catalog(self):
        """Core Android system and Google TV components resolve with Category System & Core."""

    def test_catalog_case_insensitivity(self):
        """Package lookup is case-insensitive and whitespace resilient."""
        self.assertEqual(get_app_name("COM.NETFLIX.NINJA"), "Netflix")

# ==============================================================================
# Suite 2: Tokenized Fallback Heuristic
# ==============================================================================

class TestFallbackHeuristic(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verifies tokenizer, regex extraction, compound decomposition, acronyms, and categories."""

    def test_camelcase_tokenization(self):
        """camelCase and PascalCase identifiers split cleanly into capitalized words."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.vendor.mySuperPlayer"), "My Super Player")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.dev.SmartTubeNext"), "Smart Tube Next")

    def test_snake_case_tokenization(self):
        """snake_case identifiers split cleanly."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("org.tools.speed_test_pro"), "Speed Test Pro")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.live_stream_viewer"), "Live Stream Viewer")

    def test_kebab_case_tokenization(self):
        """kebab-case identifiers split cleanly."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("net.cloud.retro-gaming-hub"), "Retro Gaming Hub")

    def test_reverse_domain_prefix_stripping(self):
        """Leading TLDs and ecosystem domain prefixes are stripped."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.google.android.apps.tv.sampleapp"), "Sampleapp")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager"), "Muntashirakon App Manager")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("uk.co.bbc.news"), "Bbc News")

    def test_acronym_preservation(self):
        """Technical, video, and audio acronyms remain uppercase."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.example.iptv.hd"), "Example IPTV HD")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.test.dvr.sdk"), "Test DVR SDK")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.radio.fm.am"), "Radio FM AM")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.video.av.4k"), "Video AV 4K")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("net.network.vpn.dns"), "Network VPN DNS")

    def test_brand_casing_preservation(self):
        """Official brand names receive correct mixed casing."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.custom.smarttube"), "Smart Tube")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.dev.airplay"), "AirPlay")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.wifi"), "WiFi")

    def test_compound_word_splitting(self):
        """Solid lowercase compound words split across known prefix and suffix dictionaries."""
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.videoplayer"), "Video Player")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.filemanager"), "File Manager")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.smarttube"), "Smart Tube")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_fallback_name("com.app.systemui"), "System UI")

    def test_trailing_filler_pruning_and_tv_preservation(self):
        """Trailing boilerplate filler words are pruned, but TV and ATV are preserved."""
        # Filler pruned
        tokens_twitch = tokenize_package_name("tv.twitch.android.app")
        self.assertEqual(tokens_twitch, ["Twitch"])

        # TV preserved
        tokens_spotify = tokenize_package_name("com.spotify.tv.android")
        self.assertEqual(tokens_spotify, ["Spotify", "TV"])

    def test_duplicate_token_deduplication(self):
        """Repetitive subdomain and package name tokens are deduplicated."""
        tokens_stan = tokenize_package_name("au.com.stan.stan")
        self.assertEqual(tokens_stan, ["Stan"])

        tokens_amazon = tokenize_package_name("com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom")
        self.assertEqual(tokens_amazon, ["Amazon", "Video", "Living", "Room"])

    def test_category_inference_launcher(self):
        """Packages with launcher keywords infer TV Launcher category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_category(["projcon", "launcher"]), CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.my.leanbacklauncher"), CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)

    def test_category_inference_browser(self):
        """Packages with browser keywords infer Web Browser category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("org.mozilla.firefox"), CATEGORY_BROWSER)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.chrome.canary"), CATEGORY_BROWSER)

    def test_category_inference_gaming(self):
        """Packages with gaming/emulator keywords infer Games & Emulation category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.retroarch"), CATEGORY_GAMING)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("org.my.emulator"), CATEGORY_GAMING)

    def test_category_inference_audio(self):
        """Packages with music/radio keywords infer Music & Audio category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.radio.fm"), CATEGORY_AUDIO)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.audio.podcast"), CATEGORY_AUDIO)

    def test_category_inference_live_tv(self):
        """Packages with IPTV/tuner/sports keywords infer Live TV & Sports category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.my.iptv"), CATEGORY_LIVE_TV)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.network.sports"), CATEGORY_LIVE_TV)

    def test_category_inference_streaming(self):
        """Packages with video/player/stream keywords infer Streaming & Video category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.custom.streamer"), CATEGORY_STREAMING_VIDEO)

    def test_category_inference_tools(self):
        """Packages with tool/speed/file keywords infer Tools & Utilities category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.speedtest.android"), CATEGORY_TOOLS_UTILITIES)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.file.explorer"), CATEGORY_TOOLS_UTILITIES)

    def test_category_inference_system(self):
        """Packages with system/settings keywords infer System & OEM category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.android.settings"), CATEGORY_SYSTEM_OEM)
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.device.bluetooth"), CATEGORY_SYSTEM_OEM)

    def test_category_inference_default(self):
        """Unrecognized packages fall back to Applications category."""
        self.assertEqual(infer_fallback_category("com.unknown.randomwordxyz"), CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS)

    def test_bounded_edge_cases(self):
        """Empty, None, and whitespace strings handle safely without throwing exceptions."""
        info_empty = fallback_app_info("")
        self.assertEqual(info_empty.name, "Unknown")
        self.assertEqual(info_empty.category, CATEGORY_APPLICATIONS)
        self.assertFalse(info_empty.is_known)

        info_none = fallback_app_info(None)  # type: ignore
        self.assertEqual(info_none.name, "Unknown")

        info_ws = fallback_app_info("   ")
        self.assertEqual(info_ws.name, "Unknown")

        info_single = fallback_app_info("a")
        self.assertEqual(info_single.name, "A")

        info_num = fallback_app_info("123")
        self.assertEqual(info_num.name, "123")

    def test_extreme_length_and_unicode_safety(self):
        """Large inputs (500+ chars) and Unicode identifiers process safely."""
        long_pkg = "com." + "test" * 150
        info_long = fallback_app_info(long_pkg)
        self.assertTrue(len(info_long.name) > 0)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(info_long.name), 600)

        unicode_pkg = "com.école.cinéma"
        info_uni = fallback_app_info(unicode_pkg)
        self.assertTrue(len(info_uni.name) > 0)

# ==============================================================================

class TestFormatAppDisplay(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verifies format_app_display output patterns, safety labels, and length limits."""

    def test_format_app_display_catalog_item(self):
        """Catalog item formats as [Friendly Name] (pkg.id) - [Category]."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.netflix.ninja")
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "[Netflix] (com.netflix.ninja) - [Streaming]")

    def test_format_app_display_fallback_item(self):
        """Unlisted fallback package formats accurately."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.randomdev.myvideoplayer")
        self.assertIn("[Randomdev My Video Player]", formatted)
        self.assertIn("com.randomdev.myvideoplayer", formatted)
        self.assertIn("[Streaming & Video]", formatted)

    def test_format_app_display_without_category(self):
        """Omission of category suffix when include_category is False."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.netflix.ninja", include_category=False)
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "[Netflix] (com.netflix.ninja)")

    def test_format_app_display_with_safety_label(self):
        """Safety label appends accurately alongside category."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.sony.dtv.braviasync", safety_label="SAFE")
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "[Sony BRAVIA Sync] (com.sony.dtv.braviasync) - [OEM Components / SAFE]")

    def test_format_app_display_safety_label_only(self):
        """Safety label replaces category when include_category is False."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.sony.dtv.braviasync", include_category=False, safety_label="SAFE")
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "[Sony BRAVIA Sync] (com.sony.dtv.braviasync) - [SAFE]")

    def test_format_app_display_without_brackets(self):
        """Unbracketed name formatting."""
        formatted = format_app_display("org.xbmc.kodi", bracket_name=False)
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "Kodi (org.xbmc.kodi) - [Media Players]")

    def test_format_app_display_max_width_truncation(self):
        """Truncation with ellipsis when line exceeds max_width."""
        formatted = format_app_display("com.google.android.youtube.tv", max_width=25)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(formatted), 25)
        self.assertTrue(formatted.endswith("..."))

    def test_format_app_display_custom_template(self):
        """Custom format template substitution."""
        template = "{name} :: {package} :: {category}"
        formatted = format_app_display("com.netflix.ninja", template=template)
        self.assertEqual(formatted, "Netflix :: com.netflix.ninja :: Streaming")

class TestCLIAndTUIIntegration(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verifies list-apps --raw flag, enriched JSON, debloat formatting, and TUI grid labels."""

    def test_cli_list_apps_default_friendly_format(self):
        """opentv list-apps defaults to friendly display formatting."""
        stdout = io.StringIO()
        runner = MagicMock(return_value=(0, "com.netflix.ninja\ncom.google.android.youtube.tv\n", ""))
        code = cli.main(["-t", "dev1", "list-apps"], runner=runner, stdout=stdout)
        self.assertEqual(code, cli.EXIT_SUCCESS)
        out = stdout.getvalue()
        self.assertIn("[Netflix] (com.netflix.ninja) - [Streaming]", out)
        self.assertIn("[YouTube] (com.google.android.youtube.tv) - [Streaming]", out)

    def test_cli_list_apps_raw_flag(self):
        """opentv list-apps --raw outputs raw package IDs only."""
        stdout = io.StringIO()
        runner = MagicMock(return_value=(0, "com.netflix.ninja\ncom.google.android.youtube.tv\n", ""))
        code = cli.main(["-t", "dev1", "list-apps", "--raw"], runner=runner, stdout=stdout)
        self.assertEqual(code, cli.EXIT_SUCCESS)
        out = stdout.getvalue()
        self.assertEqual(out.strip().splitlines(), ["com.netflix.ninja", "com.google.android.youtube.tv"])

    def test_cli_list_apps_json_enrichment(self):
        """opentv list-apps --json --categories enriches entries with friendly name and functional genre."""
        stdout = io.StringIO()
        runner = MagicMock(return_value=(0, "com.netflix.ninja\n", ""))
        code = cli.main(["-t", "dev1", "list-apps", "--json", "--categories"], runner=runner, stdout=stdout)
        self.assertEqual(code, cli.EXIT_SUCCESS)
        payload = json.loads(stdout.getvalue())
        self.assertEqual(len(payload), 1)
        item = payload[0]
        self.assertEqual(item["package"], "com.netflix.ninja")
        self.assertEqual(item["name"], "Netflix")
        self.assertEqual(item["genre"], "Streaming")
        self.assertTrue(item["is_known"])

    def test_cli_debloat_dry_run_friendly_formatting(self):
        """opentv debloat --dry-run presents friendly app name and category tag."""
        stdout = io.StringIO()
        runner = MagicMock(return_value=(0, "package:tv.samba.ssm\n", ""))
        code = cli.main(["-t", "dev1", "debloat", "--safe-only", "--dry-run"], runner=runner, stdout=stdout)
        self.assertEqual(code, cli.EXIT_SUCCESS)
        out = stdout.getvalue()
        self.assertIn("Samba TV ACR", out)
        self.assertIn("tv.samba.ssm", out)
        self.assertIn("SAFE", out)

    def test_tui_grid_preview_renders_friendly_names(self):
        """generate_grid_preview formats cells with friendly names rather than package segments."""
        app = OpenTVApp(force_fallback=True)
        apps = ["com.netflix.ninja", "com.google.android.youtube.tv", "org.xbmc.kodi"]
        grid = app.generate_grid_preview(apps, columns=3)
        self.assertIn("1. Netflix", grid)
        self.assertIn("2. YouTube", grid)
        self.assertIn("3. Kodi", grid)

    def test_device_manager_package_info_uses_friendly_name(self):
        """DeviceManager.get_all_packages_info populates app_label with get_app_name."""
        runner = MagicMock(return_value=(0, "package:com.netflix.ninja\npackage:com.custom.speed_test_pro\n", ""))
        dm = DeviceManager(runner=runner)

        self.assertEqual(pkg_map["com.custom.speed_test_pro"].app_label, "Speed Test Pro")


# ==============================================================================
# Suite 5: Performance Benchmark (>10,000 lookups/sec)
# ==============================================================================

class TestPerformanceBenchmark(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verifies that lookup and fallback execution speed exceeds 10,000 lookups per second."""

    def test_throughput_exceeds_10000_per_second(self):
        """Resolving 15,000 package lookups must execute in under 1.5 seconds (>10,000 ops/sec)."""
        benchmark_packages = [
            "com.netflix.ninja",
            "com.google.android.youtube.tv",
            "com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom",
            "org.videolan.vlc",
            "org.xbmc.kodi",
            "com.spotify.tv.android",
            "com.custom.myvideoplayer",
            "com.tools.speed_test_pro",
            "net.cloud.retro-gaming-hub",
            "com.example.iptv.hd",
        ]
        iterations = 1500  # 1500 * 10 = 15,000 lookups

        start_time = time.perf_counter()
        for _ in range(iterations):
            for pkg in benchmark_packages:
                meta = get_app_metadata(pkg)
                _ = meta.name
                _ = meta.category
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start_time

        lookups = iterations * len(benchmark_packages)
        ops_per_sec = lookups / elapsed
        print(f"\n[Benchmark] Completed {lookups:,} lookups in {elapsed:.4f}s ({ops_per_sec:,.0f} ops/sec)")
        self.assertGreater(
            ops_per_sec,
            10000,
            f"Expected >10,000 lookups/sec, achieved {ops_per_sec:,.0f} ops/sec",
        )

    unittest.main()
